couplesync.name: CoupleSync
couplesync.description: A relationship questionnaire that helps align expectations and desires. Each partner fills it in separately and you compare the results together.
couplesync.heroSubtitle: A safe, two-partner questionnaire to map what you want, don't want, and where you match — from daily rituals to intimate preferences (18+).
whyPoints: Only ~62% are satisfied with their love/sex life (≈ 38% are not).
Partners know roughly ~62% of what the other likes and ~26% of what they dislike.
When issues exist, full honesty is rare – fewer than 25% of couples say they're always honest.
howSteps: Shared overview with respect for boundaries
privacyPoints: Option to use email or not
